name: icfc_consent
purpose: Stores your cookie choices and their version

name: Session and security cookies
purpose: Keep the session working and protect forms against misuse

name: Frappe chat cookies (such as sid)
purpose: Keep the chat conversation linked to your browser

name: PREF, YSC, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
purpose: Set only when you play an embedded video after allowing Targeting; until then videos use privacy-enhanced mode with a click-to-load placeholder

name: _ga, _ga_ followed by the property ID
purpose: Distinguish visitors and sessions for statistics

name: _fbp, fr
purpose: Measure and target advertising on Meta platforms

name: li_sugr, bcookie, lidc, UserMatchHistory, AnalyticsSyncHistory
purpose: Measure LinkedIn campaigns and build audiences

name: Google Tag Manager
purpose: Loads tags according to your consent; does not itself set tracking cookies

name: Search Console verification
purpose: Verifies site ownership through a meta tag or DNS record; no cookie is set
